_campaign.name: NUDT21 UGUA-pocket modulator (orthogonal SMN2 splice-modifier via APA, first-in-class)

_pocket.pdb_title_verified: Crystal Structure of the 25kDa Subunit of Human Cleavage factor Im in complex with RNA UGUAAA
_pocket.chain_A_source: NUDT21 / CPSF5 (UniProt O43809) residues 21-225 (full Nudix fold)
_pocket.chain_C_source: RNA 5'-UGUAAA-3' 6-mer (target mimic, used to locate pocket only)
_pocket.pocket_strategy: UGUA-RNA-binding site - compute pocket_center as mean heavy-atom coord of chain C RNA (UGUAAA); NUDT21 residues within 5A of RNA are the canonical UGUA-contact residues

_rationale.sma_link: NUDT21 governs alternative polyadenylation (APA) via UGUA motif recognition. NUDT21 knockdown alters APA for splicing regulators (SRSF1/2/3, SRPK1) → SMN2 exon 7 inclusion modulated indirectly. Mechanism orthogonal to risdiplam (direct SMN2 binder).
_rationale.selectivity_panel: Boltz-2 queue vs NUDT21 primary + NUDT2/NUDT5/NUDT7 (catalytic Nudix family) + SRSF1 RRM1 + PABPN1 (off-target RBPs)
_rationale.first_in_class: No reported small-molecule NUDT21 modulator; UGUA pocket is defined but unexplored pharma white space.
_rationale.mechanism_uncertainty: Ligand could act as UGUA-competitor (blocker) OR UGUA-bound conformation stabilizer (activator). Downstream SMN2 minigene splicing assay required for direction.

_caveats: NUDT21 -> SMN2 link is indirect (APA -> SRSF/SRPK dosage -> SMN2 splicing).
Direction (competitive vs stabilizer) not determinable from docking alone.
Pleiotropic APA effects - selective NUDT21 modulator still shifts hundreds of 3'UTRs.
No co-crystal small-molecule reference; Z-score is primary selectivity metric.
